title: August and the Bridge
author: Petra Yarrow
blurb: Elodie Nakamura, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
